id: cypress:cypress/e2e/api/cms/cms-page-search-dms.cy.ts::should be able to see the cms page for new store
name: should be able to see the cms page for new store
rationale: Only the final assertion is API-level (GET /cms-pages with a Store header). The setup is a back-office UI journey: create a store, create a CMS page, trigger publish and sync. Moving it to Codeception requires both to be seedable as fixtures.
recommended_action: keep in Cypress until store + CMS page can be seeded as dynamic fixtures, then migrate

name: GLUE Backend endpoint should return 200
rationale: POST <glue-backend>/token -> 200 has no Codeception equivalent; the Glue index has /access-tokens, /agent-access-tokens, /company-user-access-tokens and /refresh-tokens but no backend token endpoint. Backend-auth Cests obtain the token through a helper and never assert the endpoint itself.

name: GLUE endpoint should return 200
rationale: Asserts only GET /catalog-search -> 200, which CatalogSearchRestApiCest already covers three times over with stronger Accept-header assertions. Its remaining value is fail-fast gating of the E2E lane, not coverage.
recommended_action: drop unless the smoke lane's fail-fast gating is worth keeping the duplicate
